notes: Scope: localhost image generation and commercial use/sale of generated illustrations, with no output credit required. This is not blanket Apache-2.0-only approval of every bundled component.

Author repository declares Apache-2.0 and identifies Gemma-2-2B and the FLUX VAE as bundled components: https://huggingface.co/duongve/NetaYume-Lumina-Image-2.0/blob/69c29c441119d43405d8373c654b16827d3cf46e/README.md.

Upstream Neta Lumina is Apache-2.0: https://huggingface.co/neta-art/Neta-Lumina. FLUX VAE is distinct from the FLUX.1-dev diffusion model's weights; the project already reviews ae.safetensors separately.

Gemma-2-2B remains subject to https://ai.google.dev/gemma/terms and its incorporated prohibited-use policy. Section 3.3 says Google claims no rights in outputs; section 1.1 excludes outputs from Model Derivatives. No output attribution requirement was found.

Apache-2.0 license/notices requirements apply to model redistribution. Gemma redistribution, including hosted services, has additional agreement, notice and use-policy requirements. Any such distribution needs a separate component-level check and is outside the current local-only installation task.
